They do not affect the measurement of past destabilisation.” “The correction level may differ because the prediction differs.” “Correction is selected only on measured destabilisation, never on identity.” “Read together, these would let what is not the node’s own act raise the node’s level. Two nodes with the same deeds could then meet different levels because of where they come from. KS-32.7 does not allow it.” “Nothing that is not the node’s own act may be held against it. The same note, without altering the body, states the governing rule: correction is selected only on measured destabilisation, never on identity, and a level raised on background or origin fires KS-32.7. Under that rule two members with the same deeds and different backgrounds may not meet different levels. The road takes the reading the work has refused.
